command: pre-registration of the offline readability probe

metrics.data: first observations after the client's 10 settle steps, practice init states 0-9 only (experiments/f0_firstframes.py), every movable object's position; LIBERO-90 (90 tasks) and the training suites goal, object, 10 as controls

decisions.go: held_B PA >= 0.6 at some w <= 4 -> pre-register the online composition pilot (P1)
decisions.kill: held_B PA <= 1/m + 0.1 at every w <= 8 -> zero-shot object composition is dead on pi0.5; the fold-first route (factor tokens) becomes the main line
decisions.validity: LIBERO-Goal PA >= 0.8 at w = 1; otherwise the measurement is fixed before anything held-out is read

groups.held_B: held-out group B (factors named only elsewhere; f0_coverage)
groups.validity: LIBERO-Goal tasks that move an object

measures.CC: contrast cosine cos(d(X) - d(X'), p_X - p_X') over candidate pairs (xy)
measures.LS: spread of d across the substituted prompts divided by its spread across two noise seeds
measures.PA: pointed-object accuracy: the first chunk's commanded hand displacement (0.05 m x sum of the 10 actions' xyz) points (xy cosine) at X more than at any other candidate; chance 1/m
measures.PA_w: PA of the factor arithmetic d_ref + w (d(X) - d_ref), d_ref = the mean over the candidates' prompts, w in {1, 2, 4, 8}

metrics.plan: the overhaul of 2026-10-01 (Read -> Compose -> Fold -> Consolidate): zero-shot composition of pi0.5's own conditionals needs the policy to carry WHERE a named object is; this probe measures it offline
metrics.prompts: per task and candidate object X (movable types in the scene, the task's own targets excluded): the task's instruction with its object phrase replaced by X's (factors.substitute), and the lowest-index training instruction that moves X (factor-matched); all prompts of one observation share the noise
metrics.written_before: any first-chunk prediction of this probe
